headline: Friday defeats leave Trevecca the last side still playing
dek: AUM lost to Lynn and West Alabama lost at North Georgia, and Trevecca host Francis Marion today. Trevecca have lost two of their eighteen matches all season, both at home, to Lee and to West Alabama.
displaced_by: The standing dek is no longer true: AUM's defeat by Lynn makes the hosts' losses eight of 51, not seven of 50. The Friday trip it looked ahead to has also been played, and West Alabama lost it.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: West Alabama's goals have not bought a matching record: they have conceded 35, more than any other programme, and won nine of their twenty matches.

wire.line: Spring Hill have scored three goals all season and are still without a win.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches have passed their date with no result, and all three are Christian Brothers', the earliest at home to McKendree.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hunter Walker has kept eight clean sheets for Trevecca.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Charles Carriglitto has conceded eleven goals for Lee and kept seven clean sheets.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Patrick Schott has made 97 saves for Union and conceded 25 goals.

last_match.line: North Georgia have now beaten every conference side to visit them.

next_match.line: Trevecca have lost at home only to Lee and West Alabama; AUM won at Francis Marion in September.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
